statement: Between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-22 at least one Russian missile or drone strike causing damage or casualties in Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast is reported by at least two of BBC, Reuters, AP, AFP.
resolution: By the deadline, published reporting from at least two of BBC, Reuters, AP, AFP documents such a strike with impact dated inside the window; otherwise false.
failure_condition: No Russian strike causing damage or casualties occurs in Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast during the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-09 and 2026-10-09 the US Department of Justice announces the extradition of at least one defendant from Colombia to the United States on drug trafficking charges.
resolution: A justice.gov press release dated inside the window announces at least one extradition from Colombia on drug trafficking charges; absent such a release, false.
failure_condition: No extradition from Colombia on drug charges is completed and announced by the Department of Justice within the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-09 and 2026-09-08 at least one commercial vessel in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, or Gulf of Oman is struck or targeted by missile, drone, mine, or armed boarding.
resolution: A UKMTO warning or advisory, or reports from two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, document an attack on or targeting of a commercial vessel in those waters dated inside the window.
failure_condition: No commercial vessel in those waters is attacked or targeted during the window.

statement: The FOMC statement following its September 2026 scheduled meeting announces a federal funds target range lower than the range in effect on 2026-08-07.
resolution: The federalreserve.gov statement and implementation note for the September 2026 FOMC meeting specify a target range below the 2026-08-07 range; a hold, a hike, or no September statement resolves false.
failure_condition: The September 2026 FOMC decision maintains or raises the target range relative to its 2026-08-07 level, or no September meeting statement is issued.

statement: Between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-15 the circulation center of Typhoon Dolphin makes landfall on mainland China.
resolution: GDACS tropical cyclone records, JMA, or CMA tracking show the center of Dolphin crossing the mainland China coastline inside the window; dissipation over water or landfall elsewhere resolves false.
failure_condition: Dolphin dissipates over water or its center first strikes territory other than mainland China during the window.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds an entry naming Metabase as vendor or product with a date-added value between 2026-08-09 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: The public CISA KEV catalog contains an entry whose vendor or product field names Metabase with a dateAdded value inside the window; otherwise false.
failure_condition: No Metabase entry with a dateAdded value inside the window appears in the CISA KEV catalog.

statement: On at least one trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-10-30 the S&P 500 official closing value falls 3.0 percent or more from the prior trading day close.
resolution: S&P Dow Jones Indices official closes, as mirrored in the FRED SP500 series, show at least one close-to-close decline of 3.0 percent or more inside the window.
failure_condition: Every close-to-close move of the index inside the window is a decline smaller than 3.0 percent or a gain.

statement: The incumbent governor of Rhode Island is defeated in a gubernatorial primary held between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Rhode Island Department of State results show the sitting governor losing a September 2026 gubernatorial primary; if the incumbent wins, is unopposed, is not a candidate, or no primary occurs, false.
failure_condition: The incumbent wins or faces no September 2026 primary contest, including by not seeking reelection.

statement: Between 2026-08-09 and 2026-10-09 the United States and Iran announce an agreement or arrangement governing commercial transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
resolution: An official statement dated inside the window on state.gov or whitehouse.gov announces a US-Iran agreement, arrangement, or understanding on Strait of Hormuz commercial transit; otherwise false.
failure_condition: No US-Iran Hormuz transit arrangement is announced by official US government statement within the window.

statement: The daily WTI crude oil spot price at Cushing exceeds 100.00 USD on at least one day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: The FRED series DCOILWTICO records at least one daily value above 100.00 inside the window; otherwise false.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value inside the window is at or below 100.00.
